What the studio does

Tattoos to your idea

You bring the idea, the studio turns it into a design. In its own post the studio writes that Greek mythology, gods and ancient symbols can become a piece with character, symbolism and careful detail.

Piercings

A large selection of piercings, helix among them, plus replacing and fixing piercings you already have. Customers describe the work as precise and the explanation as step by step.

Walk in when there is time

Walk-ins are taken when the studio is not busy. One customer got a small tattoo in fifteen minutes.

Aftercare

Customers mention the aftercare instructions they are given before they leave.

Every review answered

In Larnaca since 1996

Easy Rider Tattoo Central carries its founding year in its own name: Est. 1996. The current Facebook profile picture is a thirtieth anniversary badge. The studio sits in shop 2 on Pavlou Valsamaki in the centre of Larnaca, is open six days a week from 10:00 to 19:00, and has 5.600 followers on Facebook. There is no website of its own: the website field in the Google listing points only to Instagram and Facebook.
